name: TotalSegmentator
plain: TotalSegmentator (University Hospital Basel): nnU-Net v2 networks that label 117 anatomical structures (organs, bones, muscles, vessels) in CT volumes, at 1.5 mm (five networks) or 3 mm (one, faster). Commercially usable (Apache-2.0 code and weights).
summary: TotalSegmentator (Wasserthal et al., Radiology: AI 2023): 117 anatomical structures (organs, bones, muscles, vessels) in CT, from nnU-Net v2 3D U-Nets. `total` merges five 1.5 mm part networks, `total-3mm` is the single fast 3 mm network. Also supports v2 at 6 mm, v3 at 1.5, 3 and 6 mm, and small v3 at 1.5 and 3 mm. V3 labels L6 separately and includes S1 in the sacrum. Gives one integer label volume on the input grid plus the label names.

papers.title: TotalSegmentator: Robust Segmentation of 104 Anatomic Structures in CT Images
nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for deep learning-based biomedical image segmentation

limitations: On CUDA, stream=True keeps weights in CPU RAM and transfers each part once per volume. The five-part total model holds one part on the GPU at a time. All folds within the active part share the GPU.

On an RTX 5060 Ti with a 96 × 128 × 128 CT, total peak allocated memory was 1,140 / 876 MiB for resident / streamed portable and 1,013 / 748 MiB for kernels. Streaming preserved every predicted label in both modes.
task_io: Input: a CT volume `[D, H, W]` in Hounsfield units and its voxel spacing in mm (`volume.read_nifti` reads both from a NIfTI file). Output: a class index per voxel `[D, H, W]` on the input grid (0 = background). Encoder models (nnFoundation) take a CT or MRI volume and give its encoder feature maps. For a trained nnU-Net v2 folder or checkpoint, see the [nnU-Net v2 loader](../api/volume.md#nnu-net-v2).

quality.title: TotalSegmentator test subset (7 CT cases), 1.5 mm, mean Dice
quality.protocol: A small subset of real CT cases of the TotalSegmentator dataset (not the full test split), each run at its card's spacing (1.5 or 3 mm) in the same pipeline; mean over the cases of the Dice (0 to 1) averaged over the classes present, against the ground-truth segmentations (vertebrae_L6 of the subset has no counterpart and is skipped). Original = TotalSegmentator 2.18.0, default fp16 autocast.

original16.note: mean Dice over classes present, vs the TotalSegmentator ground truth; same cases for all modes
